name: list_trigger_resources
description: List selectable resources for event-trigger dimensions (GitHub repositories / branches / authors, Linear teams / projects). Use this when authoring a GitHub or Linear automation. For GitHub, dimensions.repo must be the numeric repository id — backend rejects owner/name. For Linear, dimensions.team and dimensions.project must be Linear UUIDs — not team keys or project names. Flow: automation_list_trigger_catalog → automation_list_trigger_resources (provider=github resource_type=repository, or provider=linear resource_type=team|project, optional query) → automation_create with each resource's id. For GitHub branch/author suggestions, pass repo_ids from a prior repository listing.

provider.description: Trigger provider wire tag (github, linear, finance, stripe). Must appear in automation_list_trigger_catalog for this account.

resource_type.description: Resource kind to list: repository / branch / author (GitHub; branch/author require repo_ids), team / project (Linear UUIDs for dimensions.team / dimensions.project), or customer / product (Stripe/Finance).

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on display_name (e.g. 'xai' matches xai-org/xai). Page tokens are only valid for the query that produced them.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_page_token. Omit for the first page.

force_refresh.description: When true, bypass server-side cache and re-list from the provider. Defaults to false.

repo_ids.description: Stringified GitHub repository ids from a prior repository listing. Required for resource_type branch/author (max 5); ignored for repository. Bare numbers are also accepted.
